notes.title: Exorcist Simulator Has Launched!
notes.content:
[h2]Evil has arrived — and it’s your job to send it back.🕯️[/h2]

[h3]Enter the terrifying world of Exorcist Simulator, a brand-new first-person multiplayer horror game. Hunt demons, master powerful spells, and survive brutal encounters in haunted monasteries and abandoned dungeons.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[u]🔹Thrilling First-Person Combat [/u]— Every shot, every spell could be your last.
[u]🔹Haunting Locations [/u]— Explore sinister dungeons, dark woods, and forgotten temples.
[u]🔹 Multiplayer Mayhem[/u] — Team up with friends or face off against rival exorcists.
[u]🔹Solve Mysteries [/u]— Discover relics, secrets, and puzzles hidden in the shadows.
[u]🔹Real Atmosphere [/u]— Feel the tension with stunning visuals and bone-chilling sounds.

Play solo or with friends — only the brave will endure.

🎁 We’re giving away FREE game keys!
Be among the first to dive in —  grab yours while they last!

notes.title: Exciting News and a Slight Release Update! 🌟
notes.content:
Greetings, fantastic members of our gaming community!

We have some thrilling news to share with you about our upcoming game release. Our dedicated team has been pouring heart and soul into this project, and we're committed to delivering an experience that exceeds your expectations.

In the final stretch of development, we've identified some incredible opportunities to enhance the game further and introduce additional features that will elevate your gaming adventure. With this in mind, we've made the decision to make a slight adjustment to our release timeline.

We understand that the anticipation is high, and we appreciate your understanding as we strive to make our game the best it can be. This brief delay will ensure that we can present you with a polished and unforgettable gaming experience.

To all our amazing supporters, your patience means the world to us. We're immensely grateful for the community that has formed around our project. Rest assured, the wait will be worth it!

Thank you for being on this journey with us.

Warm regards,
The EXORCIST SIMULATOR Team 🚀🎮

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have made a small update to the demo version of our game. It includes the following changes:
[list]
[*]The beginning of the game now takes place immediately at the location.
[*]The devil, upon death, is blown to pieces and then spectacularly reassembled.
[*]Added a chat feature.
[*]Fixed bugs.
[/list]
